levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Correctly names three or fewer of the six tools in round two (independent recall).

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Correctly names four or five of the six tools in round two.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Correctly names all six tools in round two, in the new order, without relying on the round-one word bank.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Use or safety notes are missing, or safety notes are generic ('be careful') rather than tool-specific.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Provides an accurate, tool-specific use and a plausible, tool-specific safety consideration for at least five of the six tools.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Provides accurate, specific use and safety reasoning for all six tools, including for any tool the learner named as unfamiliar in the warm-up.

lookFors: No tool was picked up, held, or operated at any point during the lesson.
Round-two answers are in a genuinely different order than round one, confirming independent recall rather than copying.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
